row.evidence: Salesloft sells two packages, Advanced and Elite (no public prices; /pricing redirects to Talk to Sales), and its Okta provisioning article ('Adheres to the SCIM 2.0 specifications with the core user schema') carries a Package Availability icon checking both Advanced and Elite.
row.notes: Changed from June gated to partial: Salesloft now sells only Advanced and Elite (legacy Essentials/Premier/Enterprise packages ran Feb 2020 to Aug 2025), and the help centre's Package Availability icon (an image, read visually) shows SCIM provisioning and SSO on both packages, so there is no Enterprise gate. SCIM is documented only through Okta's Salesloft app; Entra, Google and OneLogin are SAML-only via custom apps and no generic SCIM endpoint is published, hence partial. No public prices: the June third-party estimates (~$125 and ~$180/u/mo) have no first-party source and are dropped. Drift Email (a Salesloft product) has a separate Okta SCIM integration with create/update/delete.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Package Availability icon (an image) on the Okta provisioning and SSO help articles shows a check for Advanced and Elite.

scim.notes: SCIM is only documented through Okta's Salesloft app (the 'Salesloft Enterprise' integration, which replaced the legacy SCIM app). No SCIM base URL or generic SCIM docs are published. Plan read from the Package Availability icon image (Advanced and Elite both checked, Add On dash).

auth.token_source: accounts.salesloft.com > Your Applications > API Key (scopes groups:write, team:delete, team:read, team:write), pasted into Okta as the API token
auth.notes: Method recorded as bearer: Okta's provisioning tab takes the Salesloft API key as an API token.

operations.notes: Update of user attributes supported via Okta (method not documented); email/username updates not supported. Group membership is set by a Salesloft Group ID attribute; Okta group push is not allowed.

custom.how: Okta app attributes for Custom Roles, License assignment and Group assignment (Salesloft Group ID).

attributes.notes: Docs only say the integration uses the SCIM 2.0 core user schema and SCIM enterprise endpoints; the attribute list is not published.

roles.how: Custom Roles set as a user attribute in the Okta app.

limitations.text: Email address / username cannot be updated through the integration.
Groups cannot be pushed from Okta; only a Salesloft Group ID is assigned.
Only one Okta app version (legacy or Salesloft Enterprise) can be used at a time.
Legacy Okta app does not include roles or groups.

capabilities.notes: No create or delete user endpoint is listed in the public API reference.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch a user by User ID or GUID

rate_limits.text: 600 cost per minute per team (default endpoint cost 1; higher cost for page > 100).

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Salesloft's Entra SSO guide uses a non-gallery application; no Entra provisioning documented.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin; no Google provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: Salesloft's OneLogin guide uses the generic SAML Test Connector (IdP).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's article covers SAML SSO only.
